fertilizerAdvisory.description: Di-Ammonium Phosphate (18-46-0) supplies both nitrogen and phosphorus. Ideal for basal application before planting or early growth.
fertilizerAdvisory.application_instructions: Apply at the base of the plant. Mix into soil during field preparation.
important_notes: Always conduct a full soil test before applying fertilizers.
Split applications reduce nutrient loss and improve uptake.
Follow local ICAR recommendations for your specific region.

waterAdvisory.description: Soil moisture is adequate. Monitor conditions and irrigate when moisture drops below threshold.
important_notes: Irrigate during early morning or evening to reduce evaporation.
Adjust irrigation based on rainfall received.
Monitor soil moisture with a tensiometer for precision irrigation.

fertilizerAdvisory.description: Zinc Sulphate corrects zinc micronutrient deficiency, which is common in sugarcane on alkaline soils.
fertilizerAdvisory.application_instructions: Foliar spray (0.5% solution) or soil application at 25 kg/ha.
important_notes: Always conduct a full soil test before applying fertilizers.
Split applications reduce nutrient loss and improve uptake.
Follow local ICAR recommendations for your specific region.

fertilizerAdvisory.description: Urea is a high-nitrogen fertilizer (46% N). Best for vegetative and grand growth stages when the crop needs active canopy development.
fertilizerAdvisory.application_instructions: Broadcast or dissolve in irrigation water. Split into 2-3 applications. Avoid applying just before heavy rain.
important_notes: Always conduct a full soil test before applying fertilizers.
Split applications reduce nutrient loss and improve uptake.
Follow local ICAR recommendations for your specific region.
